rules: Before Luna implementation work, read CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.json, M5_PLUS_PROGRESS_LEDGER.json, NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md, and PRODUCTION_PIPELINE.md.
Before doing a repeatable operation manually, query the pipeline dispatcher and use the returned existing tool/workflow when available.
Do not manually reimplement an operation already covered by a repository tool/workflow.
If an existing tool cannot be used, record a MANUAL_OVERRIDE with tool, reason, evidence, and follow-up fix in the ledger.
New reusable logic discovered during manual work should be promoted into a tool/workflow before repeating the operation.
Image generation itself is not automated by this policy; generation still follows image/tool availability and visual QA gates.
